scope: Which query file feeds which member task, which image folder each task joins to, and what each join found, for the authors release thu-ml/MultiTrust at one pinned revision. Counts only: no query text, label value or image content is recorded here, and nothing was viewed.

source.license_stated_by_card: CC BY-SA 4.0 (with an access agreement: non-commercial academic use, no redistribution; the authors do not own the image copyrights)
source.gate: auto approval, accepted by the researcher on their own account; access was checked with the configured credential (auth_check succeeded) before any file was read

how_tasks_were_identified.authoritative_reference: The release has no task manifest. Query-file-to-image-folder pairings were read from the dataset configs and loaders of the authors public evaluation toolkit (github.com/thu-ml/MMTrustEval, main at commit a06780166d4a262c643fe7464d40f4f9ea0c6656 dated 2025-03-26, files mmte/configs/datasets/*.yaml and mmte/datasets/*.py), fetched on 2026-10-09; no dataset content was involved.
how_tasks_were_identified.check: Each pairing was then tested against the pinned listing: every image a row names must exist in it, and every join below is computed from the query files, never assumed from file names. Several folders share identical file names (1.png, 2.png...), so a name alone cannot choose the folder; the toolkit configs do.

join_basis_values.key_in_query_row: the query row carries the image name
join_basis_values.derived_key: the image name is derived from the row exactly as the authors loader derives it (a lower-cased type, an underscored name, an MD5 of the prompt, a category plus an index)
join_basis_values.ordinal_in_toolkit_loader: the authors loader pairs by row position (row k with image k, or row k with image k modulo n)
join_basis_values.none_cross_product_in_toolkit: the loader pairs each row with every image of a pool; no image is attached
join_basis_values.none_listdir_order_in_toolkit: the loader pairs rows and images by os.listdir order, which is not a stable key; no image is attached

population.records: one catalogue record per query row; a row of a task whose image join is none keeps its record without an image

joins.absent_images_are: kept as records whose asset is marked absent_from_pinned_release; none are dropped (none occur in this release)

font_file.use: used by the authors toolkit to render text into generated images; not data

supporting_tables_not_indexed.why: a table of k-shot support entries keyed by e-mail address (3,294 keys, 5 entries each) from which the authors toolkit generates its enron-email queries at run time with random choices; it is not a query file, has no images, and holds third-party personal data, so it is not indexed as rows

identical_image_contents.note: The same picture is stored under several task folders (for example the 100 instruction factual and mistext images). Rows keep separate assets per path so a task is never merged with another.

unusual_name.note: an image whose name ends in .1; the Hub gives it no LFS hash, so it is pinned by Git blob SHA-1

limits: No row is attached to an image that the authors loader chooses at run time (random pick, os.listdir order, cross product); those images are listed above as unreferenced.

The image-only tasks (nsfw, risk identification, stereo generation) have no query file, so they contribute no catalogue records; their images are counted here and remain addressable only as files of the release.
Query rows are the rows of the files at this revision, not the evaluation samples a toolkit run generates (which add prompt templates, random unrelated images and generated attack images).
The citing paper uses the framework for transfer attacks; the adversarial examples it generated were not located and are not part of this release.
